description: Allocatable reviewer membership. Health is not membership: a provider whose local install is healthy is still unusable unless it is carried in the allocating registry (u2giants/shared-db scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs REVIEWERS). This file is the ai-devops mirror of that membership so one command can answer 'can I use this reviewer right now'. It is a guard: never flip a provider to registered to make an allocation succeed.
